Um, Sir. I hate to say it,  
but the Child Fund is too low to
go on vacation, it seems...

It is hard on Milady, I know, 
but she will have to rest some
other way... Yes, Sir...

Milady's status can 
be checked here.

You can talk to her 
about certain topics.

For Milady's healthy growth,    
it would be wise, Sir, to make
chances to talk with her.

You can use   
items or change outfits.

Daily-life stops: 
gear, arms, clothes,
meals, church, hospital...

can be set here.

Return to title.

Then, next month, we
will follow this schedule.

We can't afford to

Morning, Papa!  
Let's give it our all!
Hee hee!

Good morning, Dad!  
I woke up early today, somehow. 
Maybe it's a lucky day!

I hope we can spend the day 
happily. Hee hee...

Morning, Papa~  
Hmm, what's for breakfast?

Good morning, Dad!    
Getting up early
feels so good, huh?

Nice weather, 
and I feel happy somehow!
Breakfast soon, so wait a bit~

Morning, Papa!  
Work and study again, 
I'll give it my all!

Morning, Dad.       
I made breakfast myself today.
Aren't I good?

Morning, Father.  
Waking early feels good.

...Oh?    
Father, you've got bed hair.
Ufufu~

Yes, yes... good morning,       
Father. How are you feeling?

Cough, cough...   
Papa, I feel so tired...

Yes, I'm fine. This is  
nothing, really...

Good morning, Da... 
Cough... cough, cough...

I'm sorry, somehow I  
feel worn out...

Yes, Papa.  
I do what you and Cube say,   
and I'm always a good girl!

Hee hee. These days, my 
studies and my job are
so fulfilling.

How've I been?
Nothing much has changed. 
As usual, just as usual.

Glad Papa's well too!   
Hee hee!
Asking if you caught a cold?

Hehe, it's fine. Dad, you're  
such a worrywart.

I thought I'd grown up
quite a bit by now...

In Father's eyes, am I still  
just a child...?

Hee hee,
Love my kind Papa lots~

I'll be good, Papa, so
you keep loving me, okay!

I want to be a kind   
person like Dad, too...

Hehe, thanks for  
always looking out for me...

But do look after your own    
health too, Father. I need you
to stay well forever!

What?!  
Nothing to say to you, Papa~!

Stop it.
Not in the mood to talk now, Dad.

...And?     
I have nothing to say to    
you, Father...

Thank you, Papa.  
If you stay with me, Papa,
I'll get better fast...

Yeah, I'll be fine after a rest.  
Don't worry too much.

Thank you... Always making you  
worry like this...
Some daughter I am...

W-what's wrong, Papa? 
You're scaring me...

Hm... 
Dad seems way too       
strict today...

That's true... I may
have leaned on Father...

I have to be more careful 
from now on. I'll watch it...

Papa, why the scary 
face? Was I a bad girl?

Ugh, maybe I did get  
a bit careless...

I'm sorry.    
I'll be more careful...

Father, I see that I was wrong.   
I'm sorry...

But you needn't be so 
harsh about it, I think...

I don't really get it, but... 
Sorry, Papa.

I'm being a good girl...  
So...     
don't look so scary...

Just as Dad told me to,
I'll... do my best...

I keep making Father worry
so much... I'm truly sorry.     
I'll be careful...

Aww...    
I'm not such a bad girl, so!  
Don't care!

...Wh-what? Why so angry now?   
Even I want to do as I please   
sometimes.

Hmph. I don't think I'm doing   
anything wrong. Dad's no saint
himself, you know!

...Father, do you     
think being strict  
will make me obey?

Father, 
you don't need to be so angry.

I can     
decide things   
for myself now, you know.

No, no, no...   
Papa, I'm scared.

A lecture, even now? It only    
makes my head hurt worse...   
Uuugh...

I'll mind my health from now on,  
so don't be so mad...

Wow, thank you, Papa! 
I'm happy~

Thank you, Dad!       
Hehe, what should I buy...

Really, Father? 
Thank you.  
I'll take good care of it.

...Giving me this won't   
make me do what Papa
says, so there!

Give me a little more,
what's the harm?

But this little bit of money
buys nothing these days...
Oh well...

But I can't use it till I'm well. 
I want to get well soon.

you go shopping with me...?

Thank you, Father.  
I'll put it to good use.

Cough, cough... 
Should I buy some medicine?

Phew...   
Work, study, daily... 
Why am I so busy all the time?

Lately I just can't concentrate,
I drift off in no time.   
And I feel so heavy...

I wonder... 
I'm sleeping properly,  
yet I never feel rested.

Is this from low Vigor? 
Sigh...

Every day it's work and   
study. I'm beat!
Papa, give me a day off~!

has no days off~!

Dad, even I can rest now  
and then, right?  
Right?

Don't ask why,
but put a day off in
the next schedule, ok?

than I thought, huh?

Cube does all this work 
every day... So he's
really amazing...

there's so much to do. Tough.

And working alongside   
Cube feels kind of
strange, somehow!

Housework alone is
this hard, yet she minds kids

Maybe, when I was little,     
I was just as much work...?

Little kids just can't sit still

my eyes off them...

This job takes more 
than liking kids.

Working at the inn
means cleaning, 
laundry... so much to do!

But when customers are happy,   
it makes me happy too!

The inn job is more physical    
than I imagined...

The laundry too, but
chopping wood to heat the bath
was so much work.

At the inn job, 
they trust me with the desk,

But part-time or not,   
I'm the face of

Farm work was

Hmm,

If you yell too loud,

In the church

Working in a holy place     
somehow makes me feel 
on my toes.

I'll try hard, and

my teacher scolded me.
